cases.title: Build readiness from a valid artifact graph
cases.oracle: Valid graph yields deterministic readiness and provenance evidence.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after the readiness record and evidence inventory are emitted.

cases.title: Build readiness from a valid graph with a second dependency shape
cases.oracle: A different valid dependency shape produces the same stable contract shape.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after the variant readiness record is emitted.

cases.title: Repeat the same graph without evidence drift
cases.oracle: Repeated input preserves the graph, readiness hash, and evidence shape.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after the repeat comparison record is emitted.

cases.title: Accept the smallest valid project graph
cases.oracle: The minimum valid input is accepted without implicit extra artifacts.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after the minimum boundary result is recorded.

cases.title: Reject malformed graph input explicitly
cases.oracle: Malformed input fails with a typed, actionable error and no partial state.
cases.stop_condition: Stop at the first contract error; do not continue or repair silently.

cases.title: Preserve terminal state when execution stops
cases.oracle: An interrupt produces an explicit terminal stop record and no ambiguous success.
cases.stop_condition: Stop on the declared interrupt signal and persist the terminal result.

cases.title: Reject a dependency outside the declared project root
cases.oracle: A root-boundary violation is rejected before any external path is read.
cases.stop_condition: Stop before resolving an out-of-root dependency.

cases.title: Reject an unknown artifact reference
cases.oracle: An unknown artifact is reported as a contract failure with no readiness result.

cases.title: Recover after a partially written derived state
cases.oracle: Recovery removes only owned derived state and restores a valid resumable boundary.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after recovery evidence proves ownership-scoped cleanup.

cases.title: Hand off a validated graph to the next component
cases.oracle: Only a validated graph crosses the handoff and the receiving contract can verify its provenance.
cases.stop_condition: Stop after the receiving component acknowledges the provenance-bound handoff.
